artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne (marble, Galleria Borghese, Rome)
artworks.description: Bernini's Baroque marble catches Ovid's instant of change — bark closing over Daphne's flesh as Apollo's hand still grasps what is already becoming laurel. The Thessalian nymph of Peneus, not the Arcadian huntress of the Ladon, is the figure the poets crown with Apollo's tree.
